Name: Slash Fishing - Dive and Fight Fish
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages: [/b]English（English descriptions are below）, 简体中文

[size=5][b]Slash Fishing 下水砍鱼[/b][/size]

令人意外的是，星露谷不能潜水捕鱼。本 mod 能让你直接跳进水里捕鱼。

走到水边，按下 [b]V[/b] 键就能潜水。追上鱼后，用武器完成捕获。

普通鱼受到攻击后会加速逃走。鱼王则会反过来攻击你。

[size=4][b]主要特色[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]可直接跳入水中用武器和工具捕鱼。[/*]
[*]地点、季节、天气和时间会影响能遇到的鱼。[/*]
[*]捕到的鱼会正常进入背包，并增加钓鱼经验。[/*]
[*]鱼王会冲撞玩家、造成伤害。[/*]
[*]通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 或 [b]config.json[/b] 修改潜水键和鱼类生命条。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]玩法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]站在水边，面向水面。[/*]
[*]按下 [b]V[/b] 键并确认潜水。[/*]
[*]追上鱼，用支持的武器或工具攻击它。[/*]
[*]想回到岸上时，再次按下 [b]V[/b]。[/*]
[/list]
在水下会慢慢消耗体力。记得及时吃东西，或者在昏倒前回到岸上。

[size=4][b]未来计划[/b][/size]

计划加入水下宝箱，让探索时有更多意外收获。

[size=4][b]安装需求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]《星露谷物语》1.6.14 或更高版本[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 是可选 mod。如果想在游戏内修改 SlashFishing 的设置，可以安装它。

[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]把 SlashFishing 解压到《星露谷物语》的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]注意[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]暂不支持多人游戏。[/*]
[*]在水下无法使用弹弓、炸弹或放置物品。[/*]
[*]与其他 Mod 添加的鱼类和地点不一定完全兼容。[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[left][size=5][b]English[/b][/size][/left]

Slash Fishing lets you jump into the water and catch fish yourself.

Walk up to the water, press [b]V[/b], and dive in. Chase fish through the water, then catch them with a sword, dagger, club, scythe, axe, or pickaxe. The fish you meet depend on where and when you dive, so a trip to the ocean will feel different from a visit to the mountain lake.

Most fish will try to escape when attacked. Legendary fish are much tougher—and they fight back.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Jump straight into the water and catch fish with weapons and tools.[/*]
[*]The fish you find change with the location, season, weather, and time.[/*]
[*]Caught fish are added to your inventory and grant fishing experience as usual.[/*]
[*]Legendary fish can charge at you and deal damage.[/*]
[*]Change the dive key and toggle fish health bars through Generic Mod Config Menu or [b]config.json[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Play[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Stand beside the water and face it.[/*]
[*]Press [b]V[/b] and confirm to dive.[/*]
[*]Chase a fish and attack it with a weapon or tool.[/*]
[*]Press [b]V[/b] again when you want to return to shore.[/*]
[/list]
You slowly lose stamina while underwater, so remember to eat or return to shore before you pass out.

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]

Underwater treasure chests are planned for a future update, giving you more surprises to discover while exploring.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 or later[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. Install it if you want to change SlashFishing's settings in game.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip SlashFishing into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Note[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Multiplayer is not supported yet.[/*]
[*]Slingshots, bombs, and placing items cannot be used underwater.[/*]
[*]Compatibility with custom fish and custom locations may vary.[/*]
[/list]
